01 JUN
Făgăraș Tranche II easement closes — 612 ha to permanent protection.

Signed at the Cluj County registry. Funds reserved against escrow account SGF-E-04812.

SOON
07 JUN
Bardún Mórr Year-7 table install begins.

38 oyster tables, local fabrication, 6 crew weeks. Tide window 07–14 June.

SCHEDULED

Aberdire Phase II audit window opens.

Fryer & Mead arrive 14 June for the peat-rewetting compliance pass.

AUDIT

Loch Awe seagrass year-four planting begins.

62,000 stems, three vessels, 8 crew weeks. Survival pass scheduled for Sept.

PLANTING

Cardigan Bay Year-3 transects close.

All eight stations resurveyed. Plot C-12 data appendix lands with the Q3 digest.
